FUNCTION LONGEST_SUBSTRING ACCEPTS(s)
  max_length <- 0
  start <- 0
  char_index <- EMPTY DICTIONARY
  FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF s - 1
    IF s[i] IN char_index AND char_index[s[i]] >= start THEN
      start <- char_index[s[i]] + 1
    END IF
    char_index[s[i]] = i
    max_length <- MAX(max_length, i - start + 1)
  END FOR
  RETURN max_length
END FUNCTION
